## On a read-only page links stay rendered when I move the cursor. How do I get at the underlying markdown so I can copy it?

--- [vault:corpus/docs/Guide/Reading These Docs.md] ---
### Read a page and reveal its source

# Read a page and reveal its source
SilverBullet uses [[Live Preview]] to show formatted Markdown. Hold **Alt** (called **Option** on macOS) and click rendered content to reveal its underlying source. In read-only docs you can inspect, select and copy that source. This does not grant editing access. Clicking a different part of the page lets the revealed content render again.

![Read-only Photo Walk with the source Reading List revealed and selected.](../Screenshots/read-docs-source-selected-source.png)
For example, this block shows the Markdown for a heading and a checkbox:

```markdown
# Plan
* [ ] Charge camera battery
```

Copy only the contents of a code block, without its surrounding backticks, unless the instructions explicitly ask you to create a fenced code block. Paste Markdown into the body of a page in your practice space. Other examples state when something belongs in Workbench’s Console or in a `space-lua` block instead.

--- [vault:corpus/docs/Live Preview.md] ---
### Revealing the source

# Revealing the source
On an editable page, moving the cursor inside a formatted element reveals its source. **Alt-click** (or **Option-click** on Mac) explicitly reveals source in both editable and read-only pages.

In a read-only page, ordinary keyboard navigation keeps links and widgets rendered. Alt/Option-click to reveal source, then select and copy it. The source stays visible while the selection touches its range. Moving entirely outside it hides the source again. Read-only access does not allow you to change the page.

--- [vault:corpus/docs/Baked Sections.md] ---
### Using baked sections

# Using baked sections
- **Bake into page** — the ⋯ menu of block `${...}` widgets (tables, lists, diagrams) turns that live directive into a baked section in place.
- **The baked section’s ⋯ menu** (on its header): _Update_ re-evaluates just this section, _Edit expression_ puts the cursor in the opening marker, _Copy as Markdown_ copies the body, and _Unbake_ turns it back into a live `${...}` directive. On a read-only page only _Copy as Markdown_ is offered.
- `Baked Sections: Update` (`Ctrl-Shift-b` / `Cmd-Shift-b`): re-evaluates *every* baked section on the current page and rewrites each body with its latest output. Run this whenever the underlying data changed and you want the baked output refreshed.
- `Baked Sections: Unbake Section At Cursor` — put your cursor inside a baked section and run this to turn it back into a live `${...}` directive. Handy when you want to edit the expression with [[Live Preview]] again, bake it back when you’re done.

Baking is **static and manual**: a baked section shows the output from the last time it was baked. It does not refresh by itself, re-run `Baked Sections: Update` to bring it current.

--- [vault:corpus/docs/API/widget.md] ---
### Widget menu and commands

# Widget menu and commands
A block widget has one ⋯ menu inside its top-right corner: it appears on hover on desktop and is always visible on touch devices. Entries appear only when they apply:

* **Go to definition** and **Open**: jump to the Space Lua that defines the widget, or open what it shows.
* **Edit source**: moves the cursor into the `${...}`.
* **Reload**: re-runs this widget only, not the page.
* **Copy as Markdown**: list, tree and table widgets copy their rows. A view with `content` has nothing to copy.
* **Bake into page**: replaces the expression with its current Markdown (the same text as Copy). Views stay live and can’t be baked.

Views docked above or below the page have the same ⋯ menu in their title bar (on hover, for a minimal frame), with **Go to definition** and **Copy as Markdown** where they apply. In a sidebar, the bottom panel or the modal, a content view’s header has it for **Copy as Markdown**. The dock menu and × stay beside it.

HTML-only widgets have no Markdown, so they have neither Copy nor Bake. Bake is hidden in read-only mode. *Baked Sections: Update* re-bakes fragments the same way.

Inline results have no button. Put the cursor in the `${...}` and run a command instead: *Widget: Copy*, *Widget: Bake*, or *Widget: Reload*. *Widgets: Refresh All* still re-runs every widget on the page.

--- [vault:corpus/docs/Live Preview.md] ---
### Widget rendering

# Widget rendering
[[Space Lua#Expressions]] (`${...}`) are rendered inline in place. The underlying code follows the source-reveal rules above. Queries, templates and widgets display their results within the document. An expression re-runs when something it read changes. See [[API/widget#When expressions update]]. Use the ⋯ menu on a block widget to reload, copy or bake it.
